exercises.name: Grip Strength
exercises.description: Squeeze the dynamometer as hard as you can for 2 seconds. Take your best score of 3 attempts for each hand.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Single Leg Balance
exercises.description: Knee at 90º and hands on hips. Goal: 1 minute on each leg.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Sled Push 20yd
exercises.description: Push the sled 10 yards and back. Record the total weight you moved in under 1 minute.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Row Machine - 500m Row
exercises.description: Choose your damper setting. Set the row machine to a custom distance of 500m.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Row Machine - 1000m Row
exercises.description: Choose your damper setting. Set the row machine to a custom distance of 1000m.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Row Machine - 2000m Row
exercises.description: Choose your damper setting. Set the row machine to a custom distance of 2000m.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Shuttle Run Line Touch (5-10-15 Yard Sprint)
exercises.description: Run 5 yards and back, 10 yards and back, then 15 yards and back. Touch every line except on the final sprint back.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Bilateral Hand / Unilateral Hand Overhead Hang
exercises.description: Hang from the bar with both hands, then with one hand. Goal: 1 minute with both hands and 30 seconds with one hand.

selectors.label: Which hand for the one-hand hang?

exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.description: How many reps before you need to rest? Arms straight at the bottom, chin over the bar at the top. Use the note box if you used bands.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Overhead Press (in 1 minute)
exercises.description: Goal: press 20 reps (chest to overhead) in less than 1 minute. Record the weight and how many reps you got.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Snatch (in 1 minute)
exercises.description: Goal: snatch 10 reps (from a ground tap to overhead) in less than 1 minute. Record the weight and how many reps you got.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Mace 360s
exercises.description: Goal: complete 50, 100, 250 or 500 reps without setting the mace down.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Gymnazo Loop
exercises.description: A quarter-mile run.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Gymnazo Mile
exercises.description: A 1 mile run.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Rope Flow Dragons in 1 minute
exercises.description: Goal: 60 or more in 1 minute.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Rope Flow Dragon Switches in 1 minute
exercises.description: 180º Dragon Switches in 1 minute.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.description: Your highest box jump completion, or as many reps as you can in 1 minute.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Anterior Triple Jump
exercises.description: Jump 3 times without stopping, covering as much distance as you can. Best of 3 attempts.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Anterior Jump
exercises.description: Stand on two feet, jump forward and land stable for the rep to count. Take the average of 3 attempts. Measure from the back of the closest heel.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Single Leg Hop
exercises.description: Balance on one foot, hop forward and land stable for the rep to count. Take the average of 3 attempts on each foot. Measure from the back of the heel.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Keiser Max Power Rotation Swing
exercises.description: Lateral face Keiser, both hands, opposite rotation swing. Best of 3 attempts on each side. Use a Keiser with a power face plate. Aim for 10 to 30 lbs.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Barbell Landmine Split Switch Clean & Jerk
exercises.description: Single arm, foot switch, clean and jerk (ground to overhead).
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Barbell Landmine Split Switch Snatch
exercises.description: Single arm, foot switch, hand switch snatch (ground to overhead).
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Zercher Squat
exercises.description: Barbell from the ground: deadlift, Zercher transition, deep squat, then stand. Or from a rack, squat to 90º.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Bench Press Strength
exercises.description: Your best weight for a 1 to 3 rep max. Record the weight and how many reps you got.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Bench Press Endurance
exercises.description: For ViPR, choose your weight. For barbell, choose 65, 95, 115 or 135 lb and go until you are tired. Goal: pick a weight you can do 16 to 32 reps at.
exercises.headline: secondary

exercises.name: Back Squat Strength
exercises.description: Squat with the barbell on your back in a squat rack. Your best weight for a 1 to 3 rep max. Record the weight and how many reps you got.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Back Squat Endurance
exercises.description: For ViPR, choose your weight. For barbell, squat with the bar on your back in a squat rack. Choose 95, 135, 185 or 225 lb and go until you are tired. Goal: pick a weight you can do 16 to 32 reps at.
exercises.headline: secondary

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.description: Deadlift from the ground. Your best weight for a 1 to 3 rep max.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Single Arm Overhead Press
exercises.description: Weight in the rack position, then push press overhead. Record the weight, how many reps you got, and which equipment you used.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Single Arm Snatch
exercises.description: Snatch from the ground (your choice of static start or swing). Record the weight and which equipment you used.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Kettlebell Turkish Get-up
exercises.description: Start lying on your back on the ground and return to lying on your back with your arm extended.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Body Weight Squat in 1 minute
exercises.description: As many body weight squats as you can in 1 minute.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Body Weight Push-ups to fatigue
exercises.description: From your knees or your feet, lower until your elbows are at 90º. As many as you can before resting.
exercises.headline: primary

exercises.name: Body Weight Plank on Forearms
exercises.description: Plank on your forearms. If you use a box, write down its height in the note.

primary.label: How long did you hold it?

exercises.headline: primary
